find.title: Find
find.alt: Engineering prototype Wiki list: scope tabs, a Browse panel with three categories, and procedure rows with visibility badges

issues.title: Duplicate titles
issues.body: Four copies of "Test Procedure 002" sit in the list with nothing linking them or saying which is current.

issues.title: Most pages uncategorized
issues.body: A fixed category list that almost nobody fills in: 18 pages, 3 of them categorized.

issues.title: Visibility shown as an email
issues.body: "Private to buildingadmin@…" names an address, not who can actually see the page.

issues.title: Conflicting filter states
issues.body: Two different "selected" styles. The orange Drafts tab looks active even when it isn't.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.alt: Engineering prototype New procedure editor: a Markdown hint, an empty steps list, blank Applies-to fields and a Page type card

issues.title: Markdown-only editor
issues.body: "Use ## for a heading" asks frontline staff to learn syntax before they can write.

issues.title: No way to import a document
issues.body: Legacy procedures have to be retyped by hand. The brief asked for copy-paste and whole-document import.

issues.title: Routing fields left blank
issues.body: Categories, asset types and keywords are free text, so they stay empty and the agent has nothing to match on.

issues.title: Layout and purpose mixed
issues.body: Page type only covers layout. There's no way to say whether a page is a help guide or a policy.

issues.title: Status in the wrong place
issues.body: "Draft · Not yet saved" sits inside the editable settings card, where it reads like an option.

use.title: Use
use.alt: Engineering prototype procedure detail page: author email, update and review dates, Pin for team buttons and numbered steps

issues.title: Author shown as a raw email
issues.body: No name, role or team, so readers can't tell whose knowledge this is or who to ask.

issues.title: Pin means three things
issues.body: Personal pin re-lists a title you already have open, team pin is a flat list of every team, and there's no way to flag a critical step.

issues.title: No sign the AI used it
issues.body: Nothing shows whether the agent has ever answered a work order with this page.

issues.title: No version history
issues.body: "Updated 3d ago" leads nowhere: no record of what changed or who changed it.

govern.title: Govern
govern.alt: Engineering prototype Wiki inbox: a suggested edit with one struck-through step and Accept and Decline buttons

issues.title: Review alerts buried
issues.body: Wiki reviews land in the general Inbox, next to every other kind of notification.

issues.title: All-or-nothing review
issues.body: One Accept / Decline for the whole page, no inline comments, and only step 1 shows what changed.
